name: ML Kit Terms of Service
content:
Proprietary. This component is not open source.

Google ML Kit is provided by Google under the ML Kit Terms of Service and the Google APIs Terms of Service:
https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms
https://developers.google.com/terms

ML Kit processes the images on the device. According to Google, ML Kit may send usage and performance metrics (no image content) to Google (details in the privacy policy).

The licenses of the open-source components bundled inside ML Kit are listed under "Google ML Kit: bundled components".
